name: PR into jayminwest/burrow is refused for the ewardGPT account (owner-side)
description: Both tokens gh holds (env GITHUB_TOKEN and the hosts.yml token, both account ewardGPT) are refused when creating a PR from the fork ewardGPT/burrow into jayminwest/burrow: gh pr create -> GraphQL 'ewardGPT does not have the correct permissions to execute CreatePullRequest'; REST POST /repos/jayminwest/burrow/pulls -> 404 Not Found (masked). The repo itself rules out the usual causes: public, archived=false, disabled=false, has_issues=true, rulesets=[], fork parent/source intact, and our upstream permissions are {pull:true} (normal for a non-collaborator).
